title: RNA Isolation and cDNA Library Construction from Suspended Animal Cells
author: Tomoko Matsuda
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.57ng9me
materials: CHO-S cells were grown in 20 ml of Gibco CD-CHO medium (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) containing 400 µL of 200 mM L-Alanyl-L-glutamine (final concentration: 4 mM; Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MI, USA) and 40 µL of Gibco Anti-Clumping Agent (final concentration, 0.2% (v/v); Thermo Fisher Scientific) in a 125 mL flask. The flask was shaken (120 rpm) at 37 °C in a humidified 5% CO 2 atmosphere.
An aliquot of 200 µL of Gibco PBS (1×, calcium and magnesium-free, pH 7.2; Thermo Fisher Scientific) was added to the cell pellet and pipetted up and down five times to resuspend thoroughly.
An aliquot of 350 µL of the buffer RLT (RNA lysis buffer; QIAGEN), which contains containing guanidine thiocyanate, was added to the pellet and pipetted up and down five times to mix thoroughly.

The entire cell suspension was immediately loaded onto a QIAshredder spin column (QIAGEN) and homogenized by centrifugation for 2 min in a microcentrifuge at maximum speed. The resultant homogenized lysate was kept at −80 °C until RNA extraction.
RNA isolation, cDNA library construction, and RNA-Seq
Total RNA isolation was performed using an RNeasy mini kit (QIAGEN) according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Determine cell counts
steps.instruction: Determine total and viable cell numbers using a Vi-Cell XR Cell Viability Analyzer and CellProfiler software.

substeps.instruction: Analyze images and count total and viable cells using the CellProfiler pipeline

steps.title: Harvest suspended cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 400,000 suspended CHO cells from the cell culture flask into 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Concentrate cell pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes to isolate the cells and remove the medium.

substeps.instruction: Flick the centrifuge tube to loosen the cell pellet from the bottom

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Lyse and homogenize cells in RNA lysis buffer containing guanidine thiocyanate (buffer RLT, QIAGEN) as soon as possible, ideally within 15 minutes of harvest.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and sequence
steps.instruction: Evaluate the quality of the isolated total RNA and perform sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Assess quality via RIN values using an Agilent 2200 TapeStation
Sequence on an Illumina NextSeq 500 platform with 75-bp single-end reads according to the manufacturer's protocol
